title: plantago australis subsp. pachyneura
intro: Plantago australis subsp. pachyneura, commonly known as a type of plantain, is a herbaceous perennial plant native to Australia. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, inflammation, and skin irritations. The plant is rich in antioxidants, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antidiabetic properties. The bioactive constituents of Plantago australis subsp. pachyneura include plantamajoside, plantaginin, and aucubin, which contribute to its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
